A GPS track distance from the mine camp to the true summit and back would settle it.

results.evidence: Lake Doris sits at 6,975 ft (route description) or 6,991 ft (state fish-and-wildlife lake record), and Osceola's summit is 8,587 ft (encyclopedia entry, trip report 8,587/8,579), so camp to summit is about 1,600 ft, as the waypoint directions (800 + 800 ft) say. The 1,400 ft figure in the sources is the talus climb to the southwest ridge or south face before finishing to the summit, which is how beta and approach already phrase it, so those are left. descent_text stated 1,400 ft as the whole summit-to-camp descent and is corrected. itinerary day 2 gainFt/lossFt 1,450 is left untouched because day figures may not change while the itinerary total already differs from gain_ft (unresolved total-gain item).
